label: US AI regulation · Blackwell-class exports to China licensed (2027)
prompt: Will BIS grant licences, or adopt a licensing policy, permitting exports of NVIDIA Blackwell-class (B200/B300 or a China-specific Blackwell derivative above the 3A090 threshold) accelerators to customers in China by 31 December 2027?
resolution_criteria: Resolves YES on a Federal Register rule or credibly reported BIS licence approval covering Blackwell-class shipments to China. A statute barring such exports (e.g. AI OVERWATCH Act) resolves NO if enacted before any licence.

diagnostics.label: H200 precedent
diagnostics.note: January 2026 case-by-case policy shows the executive will trade access for revenue share.

diagnostics.label: Congressional backstop
diagnostics.note: AI OVERWATCH Act passed committee 42-2; floor status unconfirmed.
